title: Choose a plan with Stripe Checkout (M5)
caption: FEATURE_STRIPE_BILLING=true, a test STRIPE_SECRET_KEY and STRIPE_BILLING_WEBHOOK_SECRET, a public plan with a Stripe test Price (platform admin, Billing → Plans; otherwise `422 PLAN_NOT_AVAILABLE`), and `bash tools/dev/stripe-listen.sh --only billing` (forwards to localhost:3100/webhooks/stripe/billing).

steps.title: Pay in Checkout
steps.body: Use a Stripe test card in the Checkout page.
steps.expect: Webhook `checkout.session.completed` stored in `stripe_events`; worker re-fetches; subscription `trialing`/`active`; job dispatched; OTA becomes active.

steps.title: Customer Portal
steps.expect: Stripe portal URL; plan changes come back as webhooks and change `tenants.plan_code`.

steps.title: Failure paths
steps.body: Never pay, or fail a renewal.
steps.expect: After 48 h `billing.abandoned_checkouts` fails the OTA; `past_due` shows `billing_notice`; `canceled`/`unpaid` suspends with reason `billing`.
